name: YLY-web-or
description: OER committee edition: offline-first PWA, field visits & meetings /30, tasks /20, exported into the ORMEMBER template.

paragraphs: The OER committee edition: offline-first PWA built around field work — visits and meetings /30 each, tasks /20 — exported into the real ORMEMBER Excel template.

An offline-first member evaluation dashboard (Web + installable PWA) for the OER committee, built with Clean Architecture. Every evaluator's data lives only on their own device (IndexedDB in the browser) — there is no backend: scores are computed on-device, the committee's real ORMEMBER (1).xlsx Excel template is filled in the browser, and reports are shared through a WhatsApp deep link. A leader dashboard then merges every evaluator's file into one master report.

Part of the YLY evaluation suite. Each committee has its own deployment with its own template and weighting. It is the field-work edition: field visits and meetings are worth 30 points each, tasks only 20 — and its template puts visits first (columns C..Q). Sibling editions: EHI/HR · PR · Social Media · the original React/Vite prototype lives in YLY-web.
features: 📴 Offline-first — every mutation hits IndexedDB only; refresh or lose the network and the data is still there.
🏆 Leaderboard of all members, sorted by total /110, with percentage and A–F grade badges.
📅 Global events — field visits (name, date, Day/Night shift) and meetings created once and scored per member.
✅ T × Q × D tasks — up to 10 per member, scored on submission, quality and deadline.
🎚️ Category scores (Interaction, Respect Hierarchy, Bonus) — each with its own Save button.

requirements.text: No server, no API keys: WaMeDeepLinkBuilder builds which opens WhatsApp with the report pre-filled (attachments must be added manually).
